_note: woo-publish-decision-from-the-case design D-2 (and hydra woo-citizen-journey C3/C6). The case carries its Woo publication state so a header action can gate on it and portaliq's change rule dossiq.wooRequest.published can fire on wooPublicationUrl. Written only by WOODecisionService::assembleDecision (ready), WooPublicationService::publish (published + url) and ::withdraw (withdrawn); wooWithheldNote by publish and withdraw, from the withheld list recorder. No default: a case that is no Woo request carries neither field, so the Data tab section stays hidden (hideEmpty).

wooPublicationStatus.title: Woo publication
wooPublicationStatus.description: Whether the Woo decision of this case is ready, published or withdrawn. Set by dossiq, not by hand.

wooPublicationUrl.title: Woo publication link
wooPublicationUrl.description: Where the published Woo decision can be read. Set by dossiq when it publishes.

wooWithheldNote.title: Withheld list
wooWithheldNote.description: Whether opencatalogi recorded the documents this decision withheld, in one sentence. Empty when every one went in. Set by dossiq when it publishes or withdraws.
